title: Warlocks Special Edition #1 Aircel 1989 40-Page Somerville Cover Barry Blair
conditionDescription: Covers clean and glossy with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Warlocks Special Edition #1 (1989), Aircel Comics - 40-page special edition reprinting Warlocks #1 by Barry Blair, with a new J.W. Somerville cover. Original $2.25 cover price ($2.95 in Canada).

This is the Special Edition, not the regular 1988 #1.

Back cover: Eternity Comics "Four Hot Titles for 1989" ad.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
